audit.why: Chart is all-Tristana/Skill, matching a low-mobility poke mage-marksman losing to auto pressure and an all-in jump once Valkyrie is down — consistent with packet.levelChart (all Tristana).

Spikes correctly ID the lvl 3-5 all-in window off Valkyrie's cooldown, the even-but-favoured lvl 6 window (Buster Shot vs a purely offensive Missile Barrage), and the first-item flip before his Sheen build completes. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.corrected: Added Missile Barrage's real 2s base cooldown (bankable to 4 charges) and Rocket Jump's 14s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every instance of Corki's ultimate is written backwards as 'The Big One (missile barrage)'. The kit's AbilityName(Effect) convention puts the real ability name first and the named effect in parens (e.g. 'Apprehend (Pull)') — the real ability is Missile Barrage; 'The Big One' is just the empowered every-3rd-shot, i.e. the effect, not the name. Also dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and missingInteractions flags that Corki's passive true damage (Hextech Munitions) bypasses stacking armour/MR, which was never stated.
audit.why: This mislabeling runs through winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].t/dosFull[2].d, and two report entries — a reader would come away thinking 'The Big One' is the ability's actual name.
audit.corrected: Swapped name/effect order everywhere it was cheap and length-neutral (word-order swap, same char count). Left report[9].t's instance uncorrected per the 2-report-entry cap — flagged in notes instead.
